file-browser.name: WorkDrive File Browser
file-browser.description: Read-only WorkDrive navigation: teams, team folders, My Folders, folder contents, file metadata, previews, versions, comments, labels, shared links, collaborators, and search. Downloads are included; no create, update, share, or delete Action is enabled.

team-member.name: WorkDrive Team Member
team-member.description: Everyday employee access on top of read-only browsing: upload files and new versions, create folders and native documents, rename, move, copy, comment, label, favorite, follow, share internally and externally, and restore earlier versions. No delete Actions: no comment, label, share, permission, or share-link deletion, no move to trash, and no bundled update Actions that can permanently delete files.

content-collaborator.name: WorkDrive Content Collaborator
content-collaborator.description: Full daily document work: inherits the team member profile and additionally moves files or folders to trash, uses bundled file-or-folder update Actions, and deletes comments, labels, external share links, and share permissions. Excludes team, group, data template, template library, and workflow administration.

workdrive-admin.name: WorkDrive Administrator
workdrive-admin.description: Inherits content-collaborator and adds WorkDrive administration: team folders and their members, team and folder settings, team users and groups, data templates and custom metadata, template libraries, file-request collections, and workflows. All permanent deletes, trash purges, and team member removal stay denied.
